title: Universal Plug
tagline: A small site for a Dutch smoking-accessories brand.
summary: It started as a small experiment and became an actual sales channel. The site lets you look at the product, pick a variant, and move to ordering through messaging.
coverImageAlt: Universal Plug product site showing a heat-resistant bottle-hookah cap in green and blue color options
outcome: Some traffic comes from QR codes on printed cards, tracked with UTM parameters. The site carries a visitor from first seeing the product to reaching out to place an order.
